meta.name: WealthSmith Semantic Shadow Tokens
meta.description: Semantic shadow tokens map primitive shadow values to product UI meaning. Components should use these tokens instead of raw shadow values.

raised.description: Low-emphasis raised cards and dashboard modules

interactive.description: Interactive raised surfaces such as clickable cards, dropdowns, and popovers

prominent.description: Prominent elevated panels and high-priority surfaces

hover.description: Card shadow on hover or active interaction

drawer.description: Drawer, side panel, and Smith AI overlay shadow

default.description: Default controls do not use elevation

focus.description: Keyboard focus ring for accessible controls

bar.description: Subtle navigation bar elevation when needed

sidebar.description: Subtle sidebar elevation when separated from page content
